{{Western name order|Yu Junying}}

'''Junying Yu''' (born 1975) is a Chinese [[stem cell]] [[biologist]]. She is a researcher at the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]].

==Biography==

Yu was born in 1975 in [[Zhejiang]], China. In 1997, Yu graduated from the Department of Biology of [[Peking University]]. She then went to the [[United States]] to continue her research and obtained a [[PhD]] from the [[University of Pennsylvania]] in 2003.

In 2003, Yu joined [[James Thomson (cell biologist)|James Thomson]]'s lab at UW–Madison as a researcher. Yu is an important leader in developing novel method of reprogramming adult cells to create pluripotent cells which are not from [[embryonic stem cell]]s.<ref>[http://www.news.wisc.edu/newsphotos/stemcells2007.html UW–Madison: University Communications: Introduction of Junying Yu and her work, including photos]</ref> In Nov 2007, a study done by Yu ''et al.'' <ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.news.wisc.edu/on-wisconsin/soft-cell/ |title=UW–Madison News: ''November 2007, a new study led by UW scientist Junying Yu and conducted in Thomson's lab achieves genetic reprogramming of human skin cells to create cells indistinguishable from embryonic stem cells.'' |access-date=2009-03-20 |archive-date=2015-11-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151117232451/http://news.wisc.edu/on-wisconsin/soft-cell/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> achieved the production of induced pluripotent stem cells by genetic reprogramming of human dermal fibroblasts (from a baby's foreskin). This groundbreaking result was published in ''[[Science (journal)|Science]]''.<ref>Yu J, Vodyanik MA, et al. | Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell Lines Derived from Human Somatic Cells | Science {{doi|10.1126/science.1151526}} | {{PMID|18029452}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://newsroom.stemcells.wisc.edu/14474 |title=UW–Madison scientists guide human skin cells to embryonic state |access-date=2009-03-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090209034133/http://newsroom.stemcells.wisc.edu/14474 |archive-date=2009-02-09 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Recognition==
Yu, along with Thomson and [[Shinya Yamanaka]], was recognized as [[Time Person of the Year|one of the "Person of the Year"]] for 2007 by the [[Time (magazine)|''Time'' magazine]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20071221163959/http://www.time.com/time/specials/2007/personoftheyear/article/0,28804,1690753_1690758_1693587,00.html Person of the Year 2007: Junying Yu, James Thomson and Shinya Yamanaka; TIME]</ref>
